same_law.key_value: 2026 AGA 1.0% (65% of Bay Area CPI increase); AGA can never exceed 5%
same_law.reason: Both state the Annual General Adjustment provision of the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance (BMC § 13.76.110). Measure BB amended this provision to cap the AGA at 5%, and the 2026 notice sets the current AGA under the same section. The figure in force now is 1.0%, within the 5% cap.

coverage_only.reason: This card states no increase limit. It only describes which Berkeley units are fully covered by rent control (pre-1980 multifamily, pre-1996 single-family tenancies) and which are exempt. That is the coverage of the rent-ceiling and AGA rule.
